# lab_social_engineering — Scenario Graph Reference

Tarnside Assurance has been hired to test Ledgerwell Ltd. Research the company from public sources, craft spear-phishing email, build a look-alike login page, work a pretext call to the service desk, write the report with no names in it, then turn round and defend against your own attack.

## Scenario Statistics

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Story aims | 8 |
| Total tasks | 23 (0 optional) |
| VM flag challenges | 0 |
| Physical locks | 3 |
| AND-gate convergences | 0 |
| Rooms | 3 |
| Puzzle graph nodes / edges | 6 / 3 |
| Story graph nodes / edges | 8 / 7 |

## Critical Path

7 hops through story aims — minimum mandatory sequence to reach mission completion:

**Get it in writing → Plan the engagement → Reconnaissance → First two sends → Prepare for Sofia → The hard send → Write the report → Defend**

## How to Read These Diagrams

| Shape | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Rounded rectangle | Teal | Room / physical area |
| Rectangle | Red | Lock, barrier, or interactive terminal |
| Diamond | Orange | Inventory item or credential |
| Diamond | Red/Pink | NPC or physical key |
| Diamond | Purple | VM flag (challenge completion token) |
| Rectangle | Blue | VM challenge |
| Ribbon | Amber | NPC conversation / action gate |
| Hexagon | Green | Story aim (objective) |
| Hexagon | Amber | Critical path node |
| Circle | Grey | AND gate (all inputs required) |
| Subroutine rect `[[…]]` | Green | Container (holds items) |
| Rounded rectangle | Amber | NPC in room (Rooms & Contents only) |

Edges: `-->` solid = hard dependency; `-.->` dashed = soft / narrative dependency or optional path.

The `▶` node marks the player's starting room.
